svg.text: L_(I|O) = ∫ J_red · J_blue ds — sixteen branches from the brim to the point, and a flat integrand

On the SM hat (σ = r/2: hilltop σ = 0, brim σ = ½). Each branch is coloured by the balance of the two currents; the ribbon above the front branch shows J_red, J_blue and their product: the product is the constant e^(−E).
the brim (σ = ½: the equal-current point, branches turn white; min(J_red, J_blue) peaks here)
ribbon: J_red = e^(−(1−σ)E), the descending current
ribbon: J_blue = e^(−σE), the ascending current; branches are blue where it dominates (inside)
J_red · J_blue = e^(−E): flat, the same at every σ (dashed)
